- **E.** Thread 2 passes the state check, then is delayed in resolution until thread 1 has fully exited. Its entry turns an exited tracer back into an active one, and a false CODE_SWAPPED follows. This contradicts X32b ("REENTRY on an exited tracer").

How wide the window is:
- The window needs the GIL to be released before the lock is taken: a first import of the declared module, or a module `__getattr__` doing I/O.
- With no I/O and the default switch interval, 0 of 300 attempts raced.
- With `sys.setswitchinterval(1e-6)` it was 3 of 200, so plain scheduling can also open it.

- Reason codes: "REENTRY | `__enter__` on a tracer that is not new | raise; recorded if the tracer was entered before".
